description: Building outlines 2014 is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne open data portal (data.melbourne.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This shapefile shows all of the footprints of all buildings within the City of Melbourne. The footprint is the outline of the total area of a lot or site that is surrounded by the exterior walls of a building or portion of a building, exclusive of courtyards. Coverage: City of Melbourne, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. Its tags are 3d, building, footprint, placesforpeople, Property. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2023-02-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
